notes: Rebalanced: Stat Drives (HP/STR/DEF/SPD) now apply directly to your active partner, like Evolution Crest, instead of sitting in Inventory. Capped at 5 uses per stat per partner (was 10), and the price doubles with each use already taken on that partner — the first is still affordable, but stacking several at once for under 1000 Bits is no longer possible.
Existing bonuses from before this change are kept in full — nothing already earned is taken away, but a partner already at the old higher cap can't buy any more of that Drive.
